description: 대전도시공사_오월드 에너지(전기, 가스) 사용량 현황 [electricity and power and gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전도시공사. 대전도시공사에서 운영하는 오월드의 시설물별 월간 에너지 소비 현황에 대한 데이터로 전기(kWh), 가스(kg) 사용량을 제공합니다. Coverage: 오월드. The portal files it under the publisher 대전도시공사. Its tags are 오월드, 전기, 가스, 사용량, 월별. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-05-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
